epic.title: [EPIC] Build universal Kilo Factory v1
epic.description: Build a lightweight, reusable, project-agnostic autonomous coding factory that stays inside the Kilo harness, keeps human-visible role TUIs with manual model selection, uses deterministic orchestration, Beads task truth, isolated worktrees, green-main integration, bounded recovery, and explicit start/pause/resume/stop.

tasks.title: [SPIKE] Verify Kilo runtime and inheritance contracts
tasks.description: Prove installed-version Kilo behavior before architecture depends on it. Exercise plugin loading, local server REST/SDK, SSE events, session creation/list/read/abort, session fork, directory scoping, graceful shutdown, and manual model/provider/reasoning inheritance from a visible seed session.
acceptance: Executable probe tests use a real local Kilo server.
Observed model/variant/agent inheritance behavior is documented without assumptions.
session.idle/error/deleted/compacted observations are demonstrated.
Fork/fresh-session strategy for job isolation is selected from evidence.
Any unsupported assumption becomes an explicit blocker or alternative design.

tasks.title: [CORE] Scaffold Bun/TypeScript package, CLI and plugin entrypoints
tasks.description: Create one small npm/Bun package containing the factory CLI/coordinator and Kilo server plugin entrypoint. Establish typecheck, unit test and build scripts.
acceptance: Package has typed source layout and executable factory CLI.
Package exports a Kilo server plugin entrypoint compatible with current Kilo packaging.
No system service or daemon framework is introduced.
Tests and typecheck run non-interactively.

tasks.title: [CORE] Define project config and embedded durable state schema
tasks.description: Define project-agnostic config for roles, Beads backend, validation commands, main branch and runtime paths. Implement embedded SQLite orchestration state with explicit schema/versioning.
acceptance: Roles are configuration, not hardcoded names.
Runtime state records job generation, ownership, sessions, worktrees, SHAs, states, attempts and failures.
State migrations/version checks are deterministic.
Runtime DB is project-local and ignored by Git.

tasks.title: [PLUGIN] Implement exact-job contract and structured completion tools
tasks.description: Implement the Kilo plugin surface for factory-controlled job sessions. Expose read-only exact job identity plus structured complete/block tools. Plugin must not become a second scheduler.
acceptance: Job identity includes immutable bead/job id and generation.
Completion/block payloads are machine-readable and generation-bound.
Plugin never accepts completion for another job/generation.
Factory environment/context is injected only for factory job sessions.
Normal non-factory Kilo sessions remain unaffected.

tasks.title: [KILO] Implement typed Kilo server/session adapter
tasks.description: Wrap verified Kilo SDK/REST/SSE operations behind a small adapter: health, sessions, promptAsync, events, abort, fork/fresh job session, and shutdown/ownership observations.
acceptance: No semantic job success is inferred from kilo run exit code.
Event consumption handles disconnect/reconnect without duplicate semantic transitions.
Directory scoping is explicit per job worktree.
Adapter has contract tests against a local Kilo server.

tasks.title: [BEADS] Implement narrow Beads task backend adapter
tasks.description: Implement Beads v1 backend using JSON CLI output for ready/show/claim/update/close/comment/dependencies. Keep Beads concerns behind an interface.
acceptance: Core scheduler does not parse human-formatted bd output.
Ready selection excludes epics and project-configured human/external gates.
Claim/close operations are idempotently reconciled.
Backend tests cover malformed/empty JSON and task-state races.

tasks.title: [GIT] Implement generation-scoped job worktree manager
tasks.description: Create, inspect, preserve and clean up job-isolated Git worktrees keyed by job/generation. Do not use permanent role branches as task isolation.
acceptance: Each active generation has a unique worktree/branch.
Dirty work is never force-reset or silently discarded.
Clean unique commit detection and ancestry checks are deterministic.
Cleanup refuses unknown/unowned worktrees.

tasks.title: [SCHED] Implement deterministic coordinator FSM and leases
tasks.description: Implement reconciliation-based job lifecycle with explicit states, leases, generation fencing, bounded attempts and failure classification.
acceptance: Legal transitions are encoded and illegal transitions fail closed.
Assignment generation is monotonically increasing.
Reconciliation is idempotent across process restart.
Independent roles/tasks can progress concurrently.
No blind redispatch loop exists.

tasks.title: [CONTEXT] Implement minimal exact-job context builder
tasks.description: Build task context from stable factory contract, project instructions, role contract, one exact job envelope, exact Beads acceptance/dependencies/comments, and relevant repo context only.
acceptance: Unrelated ready/in-progress bead IDs are absent from worker job context.
Current job id and generation are authoritative and machine-owned.
Stable context and dynamic job context are separated.
Context builder has contamination regression tests.

tasks.title: [TUI] Implement visible role seed-session workflow
tasks.description: Provide a user workflow for visible Kilo role seed sessions. User manually selects provider/model/reasoning. Factory records/observes seed session identity and never silently overrides model settings.
acceptance: Configured number of roles is arbitrary.
CLI prints copyable attach/open instructions for every role.
Manual model/provider/variant selection is preserved using only behavior proven by kilo-factory-001.
Seed sessions are not reused as cross-task memory.

tasks.title: [SCHED] Implement event-driven idle continuation with bounded no-progress recovery
tasks.description: Use Kilo session events to observe job progress. Idle without terminal result may trigger bounded continuation/recovery for the same generation, never an unbounded loop.
acceptance: session.idle is treated as observation, not completion.
Continuation budget is configurable and finite.
Repeated idle with no durable progress becomes recovery/quarantine.
No polling storm or duplicate prompt injection occurs.

tasks.title: [CORE] Verify candidate/result artifacts and reject stale generations
tasks.description: Independently verify plugin completion claims against Git and durable state. Reject wrong job, wrong generation, wrong base/head, dirty contradictions and stale results.
acceptance: Stale generation can never reach integration.
Result head SHA is independently observed from the job worktree.
Base ancestry and dirty-state invariants are checked.
Duplicate completion is idempotent.

tasks.title: [INTEGRATION] Implement isolated green-main integration pipeline
tasks.description: Integrate candidate commits only in a temporary integration worktree/branch, run project-configured validation, then promote through one deterministic writer.
acceptance: Validation failure leaves main unchanged.
Merge conflict leaves main unchanged and records structured failure.
Only one integration writer can promote at a time.
Beads closure happens only after successful promotion.

tasks.title: [CLI] Implement init/start/sessions/status/inspect/pause/resume/stop/doctor
tasks.description: Build the explicit lifecycle CLI. Keep it simple and observable. No hidden persistence outside durable project state.
acceptance: factory start has post-start liveness verification.
factory pause prevents new jobs while allowing configured drain behavior.
factory stop aborts/settles owned jobs and stops only factory-owned processes/server.
factory stop leaves no factory-owned background process.
factory status shows role, task, generation, state, session/worktree, SHAs, attempts, age and last failure.
factory doctor detects stale PID/session/worktree ownership and configuration problems.

tasks.title: [RECOVERY] Implement crash/reboot reconciliation
tasks.description: Recover after coordinator death, Kilo restart or machine reboot using SQLite plus observed Git/Beads/Kilo state.
acceptance: Clean/no-commit work can retry within budget.
Dirty work is preserved and enters bounded recovery.
Clean unique commit can be recovered as candidate.
Unknown/contradictory state is quarantined.
Restart does not duplicate integration or Beads closure.

tasks.title: [SECURITY] Harden process/session ownership and local server lifecycle
tasks.description: Make start/stop ownership precise. Bind factory-started server locally, use per-run credentials if supported, track process/session ownership, and never kill unrelated Kilo processes.
acceptance: Unrelated running Kilo server/process survives factory stop.
Factory-owned child sessions are aborted before process teardown.
Graceful shutdown has bounded wait then targeted fallback.
Orphan detection is surfaced by doctor/status.

tasks.title: [TEST] Add context contamination and fencing regression suite
tasks.description: Encode the previously observed stale-task-memory failure as deterministic tests.
acceptance: Old task IDs in seed history cannot override current job identity.
Wrong-generation completion is rejected.
Recovery/compaction preserves exact current job identity.
Unrelated active tasks are absent from generated job context.

tasks.title: [TEST] Build fault-injection matrix for overnight autonomy
tasks.description: Automate the failure matrix in docs/TESTING.md, including coordinator/session death, stale/duplicate results, dirty worktree, merge/validation failure, pause/stop, Kilo restart and simultaneous roles.
acceptance: Every documented failure has an automated or deterministic integration test.
No test leaves an orphan factory-owned process.
No failure can make main non-green.
No failure can cause unbounded redispatch.

tasks.title: [OBS] Implement structured event log and high-signal status views
tasks.description: Expose orchestration truth without requiring users to tail raw Kilo logs.
acceptance: State transitions and failure classes are durably logged.
status/inspect explain why a role is idle, blocked, recovering or quarantined.
No secret/provider credential is logged.
Recent Kilo session evidence can be correlated by session/job id.

tasks.title: [PACKAGING] Support global Kilo plugin install and project init
tasks.description: Package the universal plugin/CLI for global installation while keeping project configuration local.
acceptance: Package manifest exposes the Kilo server plugin entrypoint using current upstream conventions.
Global installation path is documented and tested.
factory init can enable/configure a project without copying implementation source.
Uninstalling/disabling the plugin does not corrupt project Git/Beads state.

tasks.title: [COMPAT] Add Kilo version/capability guard
tasks.description: Detect unsupported Kilo versions/capabilities early instead of failing mid-shift.
acceptance: Required API/plugin capabilities are checked by doctor/start.
Unsupported versions fail with actionable diagnostics.
Experimental hooks are feature-gated and never sole correctness dependencies.

tasks.title: [DOCS] Write universal project onboarding and operations guide
tasks.description: Document installation, factory init, role config, Beads setup, visible Kilo TUIs/manual model selection, overnight operation, status inspection, pause/resume/stop and recovery.
acceptance: A new Git project can be factory-enabled from the guide.
No project-specific role names are assumed.
Stop semantics and zero-background-process expectation are explicit.
Troubleshooting is based on doctor/status rather than hidden files.

tasks.title: [RELEASE] Prove multi-cycle unattended factory acceptance
tasks.description: Run an end-to-end disposable fixture with multiple roles/tasks across several full cycles. The user-facing role sessions remain visible and manually model-configurable; production work uses isolated job sessions; integration stays green; stop fully folds the factory away.
acceptance: At least three complete ready->job->result->integration->validation->close cycles run without manual repair.
At least two roles execute concurrently.
No stale task contamination or duplicate dispatch occurs.
Main stays green through an induced validation failure.
Factory restart reconciles correctly.
factory stop leaves zero factory-owned coordinator/server/job processes.
Release notes state any remaining experimental Kilo dependency.

tasks.title: [PROD] Audit release gaps and reconcile Beads accounting
tasks.description: Re-anchor the project after the core implementation wave. Reconcile the reported closed-bead count against actual Beads state, determine the exact status and remaining scope of kilo-factory-018, inspect every open/blocked/in-progress release task, and identify concrete production gaps without duplicating already-covered work.
acceptance: The previous closed-bead count discrepancy is explained from actual Beads state.
The status and remaining scope of kilo-factory-018 is explicitly established.
Every open/blocked/in-progress bead is classified as actionable, externally blocked, obsolete, or duplicate.
Missing production work discovered by the audit is represented by discovered-from Beads rather than hidden markdown TODOs.
The resulting DAG has no accidental orphaned production work and bd ready/bd blocked are coherent.

tasks.title: [E2E] Prove real installed-plugin lifecycle with disposable fixture
tasks.description: Create and exercise a disposable Git/Beads project through the actually installed kilo-factory plugin and real Kilo runtime. This is the production acceptance path, not a mocked unit/integration substitute.
acceptance: A clean disposable fixture can be created reproducibly with dependent and independent Beads requiring multiple roles.
Kilo discovers the installed plugin through the documented production installation path.

The full path Beads -> coordinator -> exact job context -> role/job session -> isolated worktree -> implementation -> structured result -> independent verification -> isolated integration -> green main -> dependency release completes.
No mock replaces Kilo, Git, Beads, sessions, worktrees, completion verification, or integration on the final acceptance path.
At least one dependency fan-out/fan-in sequence completes automatically and final state is observable through normal status/event surfaces.

tasks.title: [RECOVERY] Run adversarial real-runtime crash and stale-state acceptance
tasks.description: Use the real installed-plugin fixture to attack recovery boundaries that unit tests cannot fully prove: coordinator death, worker/session death, Kilo restart, stale generation results, dirty/abandoned worktrees, interrupted verification/integration, and duplicate events.
acceptance: Coordinator termination during active work reconciles deterministically after restart.
Worker/session death cannot silently complete or permanently wedge a job.
Stale or superseded generation/session completion is rejected on the real path.
Dirty or abandoned factory worktrees are preserved/reconciled safely without destructive reset.
Interrupted verification/integration cannot leave main partially promoted or non-green.
Recovery remains bounded and observable; no scenario produces an unbounded redispatch loop.

tasks.title: [STATE] Audit SQLite durability migrations and semantic idempotency
tasks.description: Audit durable orchestration truth under restart, retry, partial writes, schema initialization and migration. Verify that semantic effects are idempotent and that state cannot falsely authorize integration or completion.
acceptance: Fresh state initializes deterministically and existing supported schemas migrate safely.
Critical state transitions have appropriate transaction/uniqueness boundaries.
Retry after interrupted operations cannot double-complete, double-integrate, or duplicate ownership.
Corrupt or incompatible state fails closed with actionable diagnostics.
Crash/restart tests cover the highest-risk persistence boundaries discovered by the audit.

tasks.title: [SECURITY] Audit destructive boundaries ownership and repository containment
tasks.description: Audit every operation that can mutate or delete local state: process/session termination, worktree cleanup, path handling, shell/process invocation, result authority, candidate promotion and repository boundaries. Prioritize prevention of accidental destruction outside factory-owned scope.
acceptance: Destructive cleanup requires positive factory ownership and validated repository/worktree paths.
PID reuse, stale ownership records, foreign Kilo processes and unrelated user worktrees cannot be mistaken for factory-owned resources.
Stale/foreign completion authority cannot promote code or mutate current job truth.
Command/process invocation avoids avoidable injection and path-confusion hazards.
Security-relevant defects discovered by the audit gain focused regression coverage.

tasks.title: [SOAK] Prove concurrent multi-role stability and bounded resource use
tasks.description: Run repeated real jobs and recovery cycles with concurrent roles. Inspect child processes, sessions, worktrees, SQLite/event state, file descriptors and logs for leaks or unbounded accumulation.
acceptance: At least two roles execute concurrently for repeated cycles without cross-job contamination or ownership races.
Repeated cycles do not accumulate orphan factory-owned processes or sessions.
Worktree/runtime-state cleanup follows an explicit safe policy and does not grow without bound accidentally.
Event/log/state growth has a deliberate maintainable policy rather than an accidental infinite append path.
The factory remains functional after the soak sequence and main remains green.

tasks.title: [FRESH] Prove clean-clone clean-install production acceptance
tasks.description: Validate the release candidate from a fresh clone/install with no inherited node_modules, build output, SQLite state, old worktrees, Kilo job sessions, or developer-specific local configuration.
acceptance: Documented install/build/init commands succeed from a clean clone.
The installed plugin is discovered by real Kilo without undeclared developer-machine assumptions.
A disposable real-runtime lifecycle completes from the clean environment.
Restart/reconciliation still succeeds in the clean environment.
No secret, absolute developer path, stale runtime artifact, or hidden prerequisite is required.

tasks.title: [SELFHOST] Dogfood kilo-factory on its own remaining Beads
tasks.description: Use kilo-factory itself to execute suitable remaining kilo-factory work through the normal production path. Self-hosting must not receive bypasses for context, verification, ownership or integration.
acceptance: At least one meaningful remaining kilo-factory bead is executed by the factory itself when the environment permits.
Self-hosted work uses normal job sessions, generation fencing, worktrees, structured completion, verification and green-main integration.
No special self-host-only trust bypass is introduced.
Any defect exposed by self-hosting is tracked as a discovered-from bead and fixed or explicitly blocked with evidence.

tasks.title: [RELEASE] Pass final production-readiness gate
tasks.description: Authoritative ship/no-ship gate. Do not close from child status alone and do not treat a green unit suite as production evidence. Re-run the complete release evidence on the final candidate.
acceptance: All achievable production beads are closed; any remainder is a genuine external blocker with precise evidence and safe owner steps.
Unit/integration/regression tests, typecheck, lint where configured, and production build pass on the final candidate.
Real installed-plugin E2E, adversarial recovery, multi-role soak and clean-install acceptance pass.
Self-hosting acceptance passes where the environment permits it.
Main is green and git status is clean with no uncommitted production work.
No unresolved P0/P1 production defect remains except a documented external blocker.
Exact commands and results used for the gate are recorded in Beads/comments or release evidence.

tasks.title: [REPORT] Write final night-shift production report
tasks.description: Write NIGHT_SHIFT_REPORT.md after the production gate has actually run. The report is evidence for the owner, not a substitute for completing the gate.
acceptance: Report lists implemented production work and defects discovered/fixed.
Report summarizes meaningful architecture changes and remaining limitations.
Report records real E2E, failure/recovery, soak, clean-install and self-hosting results.
Report includes exact final test/typecheck/lint/build results and final Beads state.
Report lists any genuine external blockers with evidence.
Report gives exact commands the owner can run to independently verify the release.
